attribution_conclusion.hierarchy_level: Under the tested Q4_K_M -> Q8_0 comparison, increased base precision produced no material improvement and therefore does not support quantization as a major driver of the observed deployment gap
attribution_conclusion.statement: Controlled Attribution Findings — Phase 8.1: 1) Precision Effect: Under the tested Q4_K_M -> Q8_0 comparison at historical generation settings (temp=0.1, num_predict=80), increased base precision produced no material improvement (27/60 vs 28/60; Smoke: 6 vs 6, Core: 20 vs 20) and therefore does not support quantization as a major driver of the observed deployment gap. 2) Generation Configuration Effect: Expanding generation budget from 80 to 256 tokens under greedy decoding (Condition B) yields +11 points (Smoke: 9/10, Core: 27/30). However, Condition B changed both temperature (0.1 -> 0.0) and num_predict (80 -> 256) simultaneously, so the separate contribution of temperature remains unresolved. 3) Adversarial Refusal Gap: The remaining gap is concentrated in the Adversarial tier (2/20), which requires the CHATR Enterprise Business Governance system prompt for refusal alignment.
